constraints: Use Python 3.8 or newer and only the standard library
Store data in a human-readable local JSON file
Keep the command syntax and stored-data behavior testable
goals: Add a task and save it locally
List unfinished tasks after restarting the program
Mark a task complete without losing other tasks
idea: Build a small offline command-line task list for one person. The program stores its data locally and keeps working without an internet connection.
non_goals: No due dates, reminders, tags, or recurring tasks in the first release
title: Pocket List
